enCours.sujet: Final test loop on the final commit
enCours.ouEnEst: The final commit is frozen since 15:21. The full test loop passed 30 of 30 on it, with the app built for that exact commit.

enCours.sujet: Fluidity gate on the final commit
enCours.ouEnEst: The fluidity gate passed: smoother on 19 of 23 screens (JS stutter down, e.g. back from a Take 3.3 → 2.3 s, profile 2.8 → 2.1 s); launch to the home screen about 0.2 s faster (median 5.2 → 5.0 s).

enCours.sujet: Spam round: cold starts, wrong redirections, fast taps in bursts
enCours.ouEnEst: Running now on the bench: cold starts, tab and feed bursts, open and close, sharing, redirections, avatar and location.
enCours.reste: Then the sheet of gains in milliseconds, and your go for the build.

enCours.sujet: Your go for the iPhone build 197
enCours.ouEnEst: Staging is redeployed. The go page lists what is in the build, what is not and why, and what to test on your iPhone.
enCours.reste: The build starts on your go.

enCours.sujet: Avatars: the hand follows the jacket
enCours.ouEnEst: Moved out of build 197: no setting passes both the wrist check and the jacket check. The real repair touches the mesh deformation and takes several hours.

enCours.sujet: Game video save kept, and the profile song replaying once finished
enCours.ouEnEst: Both go out as an over-the-air update after the build, once green and reviewed.

enCours.sujet: Friends: a tap right after the list opens can be lost
enCours.ouEnEst: A known limit, already present before build 197: the tap lands while the list redraws.

enCours.sujet: Android: catching up with iPhone, like X on Android
enCours.ouEnEst: The Android changes keep going; the ones that also touch the iPhone wait until build 197 is out.

enCours.sujet: Android: larger touch areas and very large text
enCours.ouEnEst: You said it is not needed for this iPhone build, but to keep working on it.
enCours.reste: Android captures after build 197, then your OK on the look.

enCours.ouEnEst: You said: later, at the public launch. Merging it applies nothing by itself.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me and six Claude agents (the last iPhone pull requests for build 197; the go page and test notes; the regression re-reads; the search for leftover fades; the bench tools; the test fixes), six Codex agents on the avatars, four Codex agents on Android and five Codex agents with a Claude lead on the desktop website.
Replicas: stopped and our machines deleted, by your order; nothing is done there, its branches are only picked up and finished here.
etapes: Finish the spam round on the final commit and fix any regression it finds.
Write the sheet of gains in milliseconds for build 197.
Then your go, and the iPhone build 197 starts. The game video save and the profile song replay follow as an over-the-air update.
